name: CSOAI-ORG/meok-compliance-gateway
title: MEOK Compliance Gateway
description: MEOK Compliance Gateway — the keystone of the MEOK / CSOAI / SOV3 fleet. Ed25519 sigils + x402 per-call USDC billing + 6 MCP tools (4 free, 2 paywalled). 13 unified governance frameworks (EU AI Act, GDPR, HIPAA, DORA, NIS2, CRA, CSRD, ESG, ISO 42001, ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST AI RMF, supply-chain) + HMAC-SHA256 attestation chain. Built by MEOK AI Labs for cloud marketplaces.

tools.name: list_experts
tools.description: List the 14 OpenScore safety experts. Free, top-of-funnel, 5 calls/day per caller.

tools.name: spending_report
tools.description: Return the keystone's x402 spending report. Free observability, 20 calls/day per caller.

tools.name: audit_anchor
tools.description: Return the keystone's tamper-evident audit-anchor chain tail + head. Free observability.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Keystone health + version info. Free, no payment required.

tools.name: sign_receipt
tools.description: COST WARNING: $0.05 per call — Sign a SHA-256 hash and return a Signet receipt. x402 USDC.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: COST WARNING: $0.05 per call — Verify a Signet receipt. x402 USDC.

environmentVariables.name: MEOK_ATTESTATION_KEY
environmentVariables.description: HMAC-SHA256 attestation key. Resolved at startup from AWS Secrets Manager, GCP Secret Manager, HashiCorp Vault, stdlib keyring, or chmod-600 file fallback. Required — the gateway refuses to start without it.

environmentVariables.name: MEOK_X402_WALLET
environmentVariables.description: Coinbase CDP wallet address for x402 USDC micro-settlement receipts. Free tier (100 calls/month) works without this; Team and Business tiers require it.
